titulo: 🔥 2026 World Cup: 10 Insane Facts You Never Knew!
subtitulo: Get ready to wow friends with these hidden gems from the 2026 FIFA World Cup!

items.detalle: 48 teams, 16 more than the 2022 Qatar edition.
items.descripcion: Largest World Cup ever, expanding from 32 to 48 teams.

items.detalle: 70 AI-driven decisions per match on average.
items.descripcion: AI predicts fouls before they happen, cutting VAR reviews by 40%.

items.detalle: 100% renewable energy power for all venues.
items.descripcion: Every stadium runs solely on solar + wind, offsetting 100% of emissions.

items.detalle: Fans vote for goal-line technology in real time.
items.descripcion: Crowd‑sourced tech choices influence match decisions live.

items.detalle: Final played across New York, Los Angeles, Mexico City & Toronto.
items.descripcion: Four host cities share the final match, breaking traditional single‑venue format.

items.detalle: Over 5 million tickets sold in 24 hours.
items.descripcion: Pre‑sale frenzy sells over 5 million tickets in 24 hours.
30% of squads feature players under 21, lowest average age in WC history.

items.detalle: First-ever e‑Football tournament integrated into main schedule.
items.descripcion: First-ever e‑Football tournament integrated into main schedule for global fan engagement.

items.detalle: All stadium PA in English & Spanish.
items.descripcion: All stadium PA in English & Spanish, covering 1.2B speakers worldwide.

items.detalle: First hat‑trick in under 5 minutes recorded.
items.descripcion: Player scores three goals in 4:38, fastest hat‑trick ever recorded.

dato_extra: The 2026 WC uses biodegradable wristbands that dissolve in water, eliminating 12 tons of plastic each tournament.
